problem: The website assurance runner supported separate PR and daily viewport policies, but the workflow did not pass ASSURANCE_MODE, so the intended bounded/full distinction was implicit instead of executable.
root_cause: Execution-mode policy existed in runner code without an explicit workflow-to-runner binding.
decision: Make PR and scheduled production modes explicit in the canonical workflow and contract.
prevention: PR mode is explicit and bounded.
Daily mode explicitly sweeps mobile and desktop.
Brain regression fails if ASSURANCE_MODE or either viewport policy disappears.
